### Sealing the Servants of God
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/sealing-the-servants-of-god
Passage: Revelation 7:1-6
Points:
- Revelation pauses the cosmic judgments to reveal who is able to endure the wrath of God.
- Destructive forces are restrained until God's servants are safely marked on their foreheads.
- The divine seal signifies God's ownership and secures His people from final wrath.
- The number 144,000 symbolizes the complete spiritual army of God encompassing all believers in Christ.
- Followers of Jesus can face the coming judgment with confidence rather than fear.
